name: website-check
description: Website-Check DE: free website checker for German businesses

scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config scanner/vitest.integration.config.ts && vitest run --config worker/vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p scanner && tsc -p worker && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.visual: npm run build --workspace web && node web/scripts/visual.ts
